name: char/t1_bodies
prompt: Image 1 is the approved pixel-art reference sheet of one character: a full-body front view, a full-body side view and a close-up. Draw a NEW reference sheet of the SAME character in exactly the same pixel-art style, the same pixel size, the same muted palette and the same plain flat dark violet background. The new sheet shows three full-body standing figures side by side, each exactly as tall as the full-body figures in image 1 (head near the top edge, sneakers near the bottom edge), evenly spaced, not overlapping, with no close-up. LEFT FIGURE - three-quarter FRONT view: the body and the head are turned about 45 degrees toward the right of the image, halfway between the front view and the side view of image 1. We see the chest with the zipper and the white skull print, the silver chain with the pink orb pendant, the kangaroo pocket, both arms hanging down, the near arm in front. CENTRE FIGURE - three-quarter BACK view: he is turned away from us about 135 degrees, facing the far right: we see his back and a part of his side, the hood lying on the upper back, the back of the head fully covered by hair, only a thin sliver of the pale cheek with no facial features, the near arm hanging at the side. RIGHT FIGURE - straight BACK view, seen exactly from behind: the back of the head (hair only: dark wavy hair with a centre parting at the crown, the ends curling outward at jaw level), the hood hanging on the upper back, the plain back of the hoodie with no print, the ribbed hem, both arms hanging symmetrically, the flared jeans from behind, the heels of the sneakers. The same character in all three: a thin young man with a slouched posture, dark ash-brown wavy hair, no hat; an oversized black zip hoodie with a ribbed hem and the hood down; dark flared jeans with light washed creases pooling over black-and-white low sneakers with thick white soles. The face of the left figure follows image 1: pale skin, NO eyes and NO eyebrows - two big dark empty eye sockets (solid dark pits), NO mouth at all, the nose is only a faint shadow. No text, no labels, no frames, no ground line.

name: char/t1_head34
prompt: Image 1 is the approved pixel-art close-up of a character seen from the front. Image 2 is the same character's head seen in strict profile. Draw the SAME character's head and shoulders in a THREE-QUARTER view: the head and the body are turned about 45 degrees toward the right of the image, exactly halfway between image 1 and image 2, in exactly the same pixel-art style, the same pixel size, the same muted palette and the same plain flat dark violet background. Same hair: dark ash-brown, the centre parting visible on top, soft waves falling down both sides of the face, the near side fully visible and covering the ear, the far side seen as a narrow strip behind the face, the ends curling outward at jaw level, the same length and the same volume, slightly dishevelled. Same face, turned: pale skin; BOTH eye sockets are visible - the near one big and oval, the far one narrower because of the perspective, touching the far edge of the face; each is a solid dark empty pit with soft shading inside, with no eyeball, no pupil, no white and no eyebrow, and a soft smeared grey shadow under each; the nose is only a faint soft shadow below the sockets and a very small bump on the far contour of the face; NO mouth at all - blank skin between the nose and the chin; a short lower face with a narrow chin; a pale neck. The same black zip hoodie in three-quarter view with the hood lying behind the neck, the silver chain with the pink orb pendant hanging on the chest. The whole head with all of its hair must fit inside the frame, with empty background above it and on both sides. No text, no labels.
